tours.title: Ready-made tours of Turkmenistan
tours.lead: Routes already assembled and tested: flights, hotels, a guide and every permit. If none of them fits, build your own in the tour builder.

cta.title: Nothing quite right?
cta.text: Build your own: cities, hotel class, meals, transport and excursions — the estimate appears as you choose.

builder.title: Build your own tour of Turkmenistan
builder.lead: Nine steps: cities, length, hotel, meals, transport and activities. The price is recalculated on every click, and the estimate commits you to nothing.

estimate.title: Your tour
estimate.estimateNote: Provisional: some steps are still on their defaults.
estimate.finalNote: A manager confirms the final price — it depends on dates and availability.

items.title: Choose the parameters
items.text: Cities, length, hotel and the rest — in any order.

items.title: See the price at once
items.text: The estimate recalculates on every click, with nothing submitted.

items.title: Send the enquiry
items.text: A name and a phone number on the last step; nothing else.

items.title: Get the programme
items.text: A manager confirms the dates and sends the day-by-day route.

hotels.title: Where to stay in Turkmenistan
hotels.lead: From five stars in Ashgabat to a yurt camp in the Karakum. Prices are per night, per room, with breakfast where there is one.

cta.title: Need a hotel for a particular route?
cta.text: We will match it to your dates, budget and cities — and fold it into the tour estimate.

country.title: A country almost nobody knows
country.lead: A fifth of the Karakum, the ruins of four Silk Road capitals, and a burning gas crater in the middle of the desert. The visa is by invitation, and we arrange it.

reviews.title: What the people who went say
reviews.lead: Reviews are written after the trip. We do not delete the fours — they are where we learn what to improve.

cta.title: Want the same?
cta.text: Tell us where and when — we will build the route and price it.

gallery.title: Turkmenistan in photographs
gallery.lead: Pictures from the trips: desert, ruins, cities and the Caspian. Tap any of them to see it large.

video.title: Turkmenistan, as it looks
video.lead: Clips from the trips — no editing tricks and no stock footage.
video.noPlayer: Your browser cannot play this video.

home.heroTitle: A country still waiting to be discovered
home.heroLead: The Karakum, the ruins of four Silk Road capitals, and a crater that has burned since 1971. Routes with the visa, the hotels and the guide — around your dates.
